classification_rule: a simultaneous decidable violation always precedes opacity

calibrations.violated: catalog, join, hash, source, proof, status, novelty, provenance or safety failure
calibrations.unknown: real unbound, ambiguous, uncatalogued or insufficient evidence without overclaim

calibrations.preserved: strict valid request plus idempotent reuse or ordered fresh admission
calibrations.violated: invalid text/enum/limit/ref/pair/policy or incorrect prequeue/admission relation
calibrations.unknown: source basis unavailable before idempotency with no state mutation

calibrations.violated: status exclusivity, terminal progress or lifecycle relation fails
calibrations.unknown: terminal epistemic insufficiency with no overclaim

calibrations.preserved: name, fixed-order canonical bytes, hash, size, cursor and safe document hold
calibrations.violated: integrity, binding, pagination or safety predicate fails
calibrations.unknown: artifact content carries a permitted unresolved state or availability is not evidenced

calibrations.preserved: CAS request and permitted response representation do no new work
calibrations.violated: admission, worker/publication side effect, version regression or invalid lifecycle
calibrations.unknown: terminal race remains unobservable without contradictory claim

calibrations.preserved: frozen input integrity, produced hash validity, zero network and sequence determinism
calibrations.violated: input integrity, output hash or offline invariant fails
calibrations.unknown: valid frozen capture cannot establish provider availability/effect

calibrations.preserved: ten tools and R3-demonstrable exact order/surface
all receipts, identities and layer boundaries verified
calibrations.violated: audit overclaims or contradicts observed evidence
calibrations.unknown: receipt, identity or layer evidence remains incomplete without overclaim
